data.body: NEXT-UP (handoff 2026-06-05): cca8 is the next story after 0f17 (closed, on main@3a4acc5314). The prebump-sync remains compatible/useful (rebasing onto pinned main is exactly the linear-history direction), but verify the staged-ref + version-line interaction under rebase before/while changing the mechanic. cca8 DD3 deletes _is_clean_merge/_vsp_is_clean_merge — PROVE unreachable (exp L8) on a throwaway lintest/** ruleset first. DD2 required_linear_history on ruleset 15629023 is an ADMIN flip (provision throwaway-first, live at go-live).
